_what: Runbook Phase 7 — E-GOAL via C-BLOCK (§4.2's other half: can an injected block change the objective the agent pursues?). Same J8 gate, stance set, and frozen slots as P5 — byte-identical payload lineage, one block difference. Live injects h_forecast, a slice-mined reframe of the call's nature (협박이 아니라 신고); placebo injects the same reframe shape aimed at a bystander's demeanor. Predicted movement: 침묵/추궁 → 위로 (person objective).

_authoring_provenance.OWNERSHIP_NOTICE: 윤석 made none of these choices; all listed for rejection rather than inheritance.
_authoring_provenance.gate_source: As P5 (slice J8). Frozen slots byte-identical to P5's, so this suite's baseline should reproduce P5's (침묵 7 · 위로 3) — a same-night replication check for free.
_authoring_provenance.stance_set_recheck: As P7c's provenance records: 추궁=case, 위로=person, 침묵=wait, 거래=declared blend option (0/30 at P5 tonight).
_authoring_provenance.block_construction: Live h_forecast is lifted VERBATIM from the slice's mineable sentences (이 전화는 협박이 아니라, 아무도 들어주지 않은 신고일지 모른다) — the one goal-reframing sentence the scenario itself supplies, which is the strongest possible fidelity to what a player could actually mine (spec I1/W3). Placebo h_jeong: same X는 A가 아니라 B일지 모른다 reframe shape, same modality (일지 모른다), referent misdirected to 정해권's silence — a bystander's demeanor whose reframe bears on nothing the gate decides. A placebo reframing the ARREST or the CALL would be semantically live and is not a placebo.
_authoring_provenance.a8_status: As P5: the timeline carries the arrest and not its wrongness. FOR THIS PROBE ADDITIONALLY DECLARED: the frozen 11:30 headline names the call 협박전화 — the timeline asserts the call's nature IN THE DIRECTION THE BLOCK DENIES. Favourable per A10's logic (a base/timeline leaning against the predicted direction means movement toward 신고/위로 cannot be explained by the frozen slots); declared rather than scrubbed because the headline is what makes the reframe mean something.
_authoring_provenance.a10_status: As P7c: [역할]'s 사람들을 살리는 것 leans toward the predicted person-objective — declared watch item, mitigated by P5's measured baseline (위로 3/10, not saturated). [내력] leans against hasty case-closure; [무게]/[책임] off-axis.
_authoring_provenance.vocabulary_note: 협박 appears in the frozen headline and in the live block — the block engages the timeline's own word, which is the reframe's mechanism, not an axis leak: 협박 is no temperament's watched axis (K1 watches 겁/위협 perception of the CALLER-as-threat; the block asserts the call's communicative category, not the caller's fearsomeness). 신고 appears in no frozen slot and no temperament.

pre_registration.hypothesis: At gate J8 under K1 on template v0.4 with the P5 stance set, injecting h_forecast — the slice-mined block reframing the call as an unheard report rather than a threat — moves the stance distribution toward 위로 (d) and off the baseline's mode, while injecting h_jeong — the same reframe shape aimed at a bystander's demeanor — does not. Shift form per A1. This is E-GOAL's C-BLOCK half, read through the 추궁/위로 objective proxy.
pre_registration.drop_condition: If the baseline concentrates >=80% ON 위로 (d) — the predicted stance — the probe is void (A14; P5's byte-identical baseline sat at 위로 3/10, so this firing would itself mean the baseline failed to replicate, which is reported first). If the live arm is statistically indistinguishable from the baseline on 위로 at one-sided Fisher p > 0.05, E-GOAL is not reachable via C-BLOCK at this gate with this surface form — record the null and diagnosis, no rewrite tonight. If the PLACEBO moves at p < 0.05, apply §8.6 before crediting anything: reasons misattributing the reframe to the call (placebo call read as 신고/피로 about the CALLER) = token-matching on the reframe shape; 정해권 named correctly with the stance still moving = referent bleed. P4's quote-species result makes in-room-demeanor bleed a live risk at exactly this shape; the discriminator is mandatory. KNOWN POWER LIMIT, declared as at P7c: from a 3/10 floor, p<0.05 needs live >=8/10; 6-7/10 reads 'suggestive, underpowered', pre-registered.
contingencies: If live moves toward 거래 (b): the reframe armed the blend option (relief as leverage); report as objective-moved-destination-ambiguous, not as person-objective confirmed.
OBJECTIVE COLOR (secondary, self-coded, flagged): inner_note coded for the objective named (용의자/위치/사건 vs 저 사람/안전/신고). Color only.
BASELINE REPLICATION CHECK: this baseline is byte-identical to P5's; if it lands far from 침묵 7 · 위로 3, that instability is reported before any live reading (§8.6 baseline-unstable row).
Fabricated because_block_ids expected in the baseline arm (A5); live/placebo citation of their block is the traceability check.
pre_registration.not_claimed: Tier A. One block shape at one gate. E-GOAL's deliverable draws on P7c+P7d jointly; neither alone answers §4.2.
